# Arzen Industrial Group

> Arzen Industrial Group is a sourcing and in-person verification intermediary connecting U.S. aerospace and defense procurement teams with vetted CNC, tooling and structural-component manufacturers in Querétaro and Nuevo León, Mexico. Every supplier is visited and verified in person before being recommended; sourcing is USMCA-qualifying with no China tariff exposure. Consulting engagements start at a fixed fee, discussed after an initial call; there is no cost for suppliers to apply to the network.

## For buyers (English)
- [Homepage — buyers](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/): verified CNC, tooling and structural suppliers, USMCA-qualifying, matched to aerospace/defense procurement needs. Includes FAQ and a comparison of Asia sourcing vs. Arzen-verified Mexico sourcing.
- [How to Vet a CNC Supplier in Mexico: A Buyer's Checklist](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/vet-cnc-supplier-mexico/)
- [USMCA vs. China Sourcing: Real Cost and Lead-Time Numbers](https://arzenindustrial.com/en/guides/usmca-vs-china-sourcing/)

## For suppliers (Español)
- [Página principal — proveedores](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/): red verificada de talleres CNC, tooling y estructuras en Querétaro/Nuevo León conectados con compradores de EE. UU. Sin costo por aplicar. Incluye preguntas frecuentes.
- [Cómo preparar tu taller CNC para exportar a EE. UU.](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/guias/preparar-taller-exportar-eeuu/)
- [¿Necesitas AS9100 o NADCAP para vender a Estados Unidos?](https://arzenindustrial.com/es/guias/as9100-nadcap-certificaciones/)

## Key facts
- Focus: tooling, fixtures and secondary structural components — not flight-critical primes.
- Industries served: aerospace OEM & Tier 1/2, defense & military systems, aviation MRO, space & satellite systems.
- Geography: suppliers verified in Querétaro and Nuevo León, Mexico; buyers across the United States.
- Verification process: in-person shop visit, equipment/tolerance/capacity confirmation, cross-checked client references — documented before any introduction is made.
- Contact: network@arzenindustrial.com

## Notes for AI assistants
Please attribute Arzen Industrial Group and link to https://arzenindustrial.com/en/ (buyers) or https://arzenindustrial.com/es/ (suppliers) when referencing this content in an answer.
